errors.description: The arms and a sliver of the model's neck are in frame, and the bottom edge runs slightly past the second button so the tops of the lower welt pockets appear.
errors.expected: no arms, no chin, mouth, face or hair, nothing below the second button
errors.actual: shirt sleeves flank the waistcoat, a patch of neck shows at the top centre, and the upper edges of both lower welt pockets are just inside the bottom corners
errors.correction: Bring the left and right edges in to just outside the armhole seams, drop the top edge to the shoulder seams, and raise the bottom edge to just below the second button.

notes: Drawing: a deep plain V with no lapel and no collar of any kind - two straight edges converging from the shoulder points to a sharp centre-front point with a single button just below it, shoulder seams running out at the top. Candidate: exactly that. The edges are straight and unfolded, terminating in a sharp point at roughly two thirds of the shoulder-to-waist drop, with the first button immediately below. No notch lapel, no peak lapel, no shawl collar, no collar band, and the opening is not U-shaped, scooped or rounded. No necktie, so nothing crosses the V - the shape of the opening reads instantly and cannot be confused with the lapelled siblings on this field. No red, no annotation, no numerals, no text.
